trial_type.Description: Indicates the modality of the trial, either pain or visual

cue_onset.Description: The onset of the cue in seconds, with respect to the fMRI acquision start (first volume)

cue_duration.Description: The duration of the cue presentation in seconds

cue_mean.Description: The mean of the 10 ratings presented on the cue

cue_std.Description: The standard deviation of the 10 ratings presented on the cue

cue_sk.Description: The skewness of the 10 ratings presented on the cue

stim_onset.Description: The onset of the stimulus (pain/vision) in seconds, with respect to the fMRI acquision start (first volume)

stim_duration.Description: The duration of the stimulus presentation in seconds

stim_level.Description: The level of the stimulus, 1 (low) or 2 (high)

stim_value.Description: The value of the stimulus- temperature (in celsius) for pain trials, and contrast for visual trials

rating_onset.Description: The onset of the vas rating in seconds, with respect to the fMRI acquision start (first volume)

RT.Description: The response time of participant's rating, in seconds

rating.Description: The participant's rating on VAS ranging from 0 (“no pain at all” / “no contrast at all”) to 100 (“worst pain imaginable” / “strongest contrast”)
